title: H-G: does gstack /investigate help Opus on bug-fix tasks?
question: On bug-fix fixtures, does the told arm (investigate skill, prompt starts with /investigate) pass more often than the none arm, and at what cost per pass?

verdict.label: hypothesis-supported
verdict.text: DECISION: H-G SUPPORTED (not contradicted at n=8; ceiling in fx3). This is absence of a detected benefit, not evidence of zero effect.

notes: n = 8 per arm per fixture, Opus, 30 turns.
The skill copy is standalone (shared preamble, telemetry and learnings removed), so the cost ratio is a lower bound.
fx3 is at ceiling (none 8/8), so the verdict rests on fx4b.
The verdict wording is the preregistered 'not contradicted at n = 8'; the told arm passed less on fx4b (0/8 vs 5/8).
